chunks.heading: From Ashes to Ascendancy
chunks.notes: Movement I recounts childhood scorn from a teacher and forged courage, and Movement II's opening stanza introduces abusers who stole trust.

chunks.heading: From Ashes to Ascendancy
chunks.notes: This chunk names a "breach of sacred boundaries" and a "flame of inner strength no terror can remove," then moves to Movement III's reclaiming of a "stolen narrative."

chunks.heading: From Ashes to Ascendancy
